items.headline: September surprises: Our unexpected all-portal team
items.description: Unlikely stars a month ago, here are the biggest portal surprises at every position.

items.headline: Manaki Watanabe kicks 4 field goals as Fresno State pulls away for 26-10 victory over San Jose State
items.description: — Manaki Watanabe kicked four field goals and Jordan Malau'ulu's 68-yard punt return set up Fresno State's first touchdown in the Bulldogs' 26-10 victory over San Jose State on Saturday night.

items.headline: Fresno State goes on the road to match up against San Jose State
items.description: Fresno State (1-1) at San Jose State (2-1), Sept. 19 at 11 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Weaver to Clark connection nets 2TDs and San Jose St. fends off Cal Poly upset bid in 30-20 win
items.description: — Luke Weaver threw two of his three touchdowns to receiver Carson Clark and San Jose State used the fourth quarter to pull away from FCS-member Cal Poly for a 30-20 win on Saturday night.

items.headline: Alabama's jab at East Carolina leads top trolls of college football Week 1
items.description: The Crimson Tide used a mascot-themed caption to troll the Pirates after a dominant season-opening win in Tuscaloosa.
